info.title: Managed Agents internal Session Service
info.description: Internal Session Service in the Agent Service JVM. Generic 0.1.0 operations are used by PI runtimes. AgentScope uses the prepared Java profile documented separately. Authentication, fencing and durable receipts apply before any tool authorization. Prepared handoff endpoints below use the numeric AgentScope Java profile.

post.description: Durably claim an eligible Turn; the same claimId returns the original receipt, never a new owner. A receipt past expiry grants no execution authority.
